## Checklist for plugins and themes

- [ ] One plugin or theme, in its own folder, with a README
- [ ] `pnpm validate`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` pass
- [ ] It follows [the rules](https://github.com/Cat-things/sunoplusplus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-rules): no getting around credits or limits, no automation, no tracking, no remote code
- [ ] I turned it on and off a few times and nothing was left behind
- [ ] I bumped `version` in manifest.json (updates only)
- [ ] I have the right to share this under the license in manifest.json
